import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Radical
theorem p2_n001 (p2v0 : Nat) (p2v1 : Nat) (p2v2 : Nat) (h0 : (p2v1 ∣ p2v0)) (h1 : (p2v0 ∣ p2v2)) (h2 : (p2v2 ∣ p2v1)) : (p2v1 ∣ p2v2) := by
  exact @Dvd.dvd.trans Nat _ p2v1 p2v0 p2v2 h0 h1

theorem p2_n002 (p2v0 : Nat) (p2v1 : Nat) (p2v2 : Nat) (h0 : (p2v1 ∣ p2v0)) (h1 : (p2v0 ∣ p2v2)) (h2 : (p2v2 ∣ p2v1)) : (p2v1 = p2v2) := by
  exact @Dvd.dvd.antisymm Nat _ p2v1 p2v2 _ (p2_n001 p2v0 p2v1 p2v2 h0 h1 h2) h2

theorem p2_target (p2v0 : Nat) (p2v1 : Nat) (p2v2 : Nat) (h0 : (p2v1 ∣ p2v0)) (h1 : (p2v0 ∣ p2v2)) (h2 : (p2v2 ∣ p2v1)) : (p2v1 = p2v2) := by
  exact (p2_n002 p2v0 p2v1 p2v2 h0 h1 h2)
